shape_reuse: The same 96 shapes are repeated in all six sessions. Test has 24 shapes; challenge has 12. These are not new unseen shapes per round.
ratio_definition: FP16 median latency / BF16 median latency: above 1 means BF16 was faster in those recorded visits; below 1 means FP16 was faster.
cross_round_spread_definition: Maximum recorded per-shape latency over the minimum across the three sessions; descriptive, not a confidence interval.
model_selection: Keep each session's frozen development-only selection. Candidate comparisons never replace the selected model after looking at heldout scores.
metric_aggregation: Across-round summaries describe three per-session median APE values, not a pooled independent sample and not a population confidence interval.
limitations: Only one GPU model/software stack and three recorded physical UUIDs; this is not cross-architecture validation.
FP16 was collected before BF16 within each round; runtime order/state can confound precision attribution.
Warm-reuse CUDA graph replay time per GEMM includes replay/inter-kernel gaps; excludes CPU-GPU transfers, allocation, capture and end-to-end LLM serving.

Recorded acquisition audit outcomes are summarized separately. The publication verifier checks exported-file integrity and reproducible numeric evidence; it does not reconstruct omitted original source bytes or original full-archive seals.
No additional GPU measurements, retraining or model-selection changes were performed by this analysis.
